quests.title: The Dead Patch at Rouse Hill
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. The number three green at Rouse Hill has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since the long weekend, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, Rouse Hill
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by the long weekend, which means finding $74 that the Rouse Hill club does not have. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $74, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The Rouse Hill Membership Count
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Our books say 68 members at Rouse Hill and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, Rouse Hill
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Since the second express somebody has been going round the Rouse Hill greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at Rouse Hill
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. There is a docket book in the chest freezer behind the bar at Rouse Hill and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, Rouse Hill
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Tallawong now, and he owes Rouse Hill an explanation about the drainage. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

quests.title: Nights at Glebe
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Every night around the middle of the news the same car does three laps of the Glebe forecourt and never buys fuel. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the car, plate if you can get it
I want it on record before I ring anyone

quests.title: The Third Lap, Glebe
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Now I know the plate, I want to know where it goes after it leaves Glebe at the middle of the news, because it is not going home. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: follow it as far as Wentworth Park
wherever it stops

quests.title: Bay Two, Glebe
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Bay two at the Glebe workshop has had the same car in it since a Tuesday and the owner has stopped answering. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the address on the job card
the letterbox, so I know I have the right house
tell me if anybody actually lives there

quests.title: Tools Off the Bench, Glebe
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Someone has been walking out of Glebe with a socket set at a time since a Tuesday, and I have run out of ways to be polite about it. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: the ones hanging round the air hose
$63 of it back, that is what the set cost

quests.title: The Glebe Price Board
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Head office says the Glebe board has been wrong since a Tuesday and I say it has been right for eleven years, and one of us is about to be embarrassed. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: buy something so it is a real transaction
the board and the pump, both in the one shot
that settles it either way

quests.title: The Other Franchise, Glebe
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The bloke who runs the site at Exhibition Centre has had the same trouble Glebe has, and he will talk to you before he talks to me. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: find him on shift
whatever he says, I want it word for word

quests.title: Level Two, Thirroul
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Water has been coming through the level two ceiling of the Thirroul block since a public holiday nobody remembered and the strata report says there is no water. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the ceiling, with the stain visible
that goes in the file whether they like it or not

quests.title: The Special Levy, Thirroul
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The photo did it. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Now every owner at Thirroul owes $116 and I have to collect it from people who have avoided me for a year. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: $116 out of them, in any state
I will not ask how

quests.title: Car Space 14, Thirroul
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Somebody who does not live at Thirroul has parked in space fourteen every night since a public holiday nobody remembered and the manager will not look at it. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: down to the basement, the far corner
the car in the space with the number painted beside it

quests.title: The Meeting, Thirroul
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The Thirroul AGM is on a public holiday nobody remembered and I would like to arrive with something stronger than a grievance and a printout. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: two coffees, one is for me
the community room where they hold it
walk in with me, they behave when there is a witness

quests.title: Bin Night at Thirroul
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Three units at Thirroul have put their bins out on the wrong night since a public holiday nobody remembered and I have taken it personally, which I accept is a choice I made. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: the ones who argue about it
the fine the council gave me, off them

quests.title: The Other Block, Thirroul
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. There is a block at Austinmer with the same builder and the same cracks, and their manager has already been through what Thirroul is starting. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: go and ask them how it ended
I need to know how much worse this gets
